_source: Radiant mainnet, fetched 2026-09-23 with blockchain.transaction.get from the public ElectrumX endpoint the /inspect/ page uses. The bytes hash to the txid.
_what: The GLYPH Protocol dMint deploy reveal: 36 inputs, 35 outputs. Input 0 carries the token's own payload (65,569-byte envelope, the same bytes as glyph_reveal_cbor.bin) and input 33 a second payload the classifier reads as an unnamed NFT. Both glyph readers read both. It is here because the classifier reported input 33 as a payload 'the reveal reader did not return' while listing it as an other glyph it had read.
